Friendzy / Classic party games / Talk Like...

How to play Talk Like...

Speak only in that accent. Forever. Someone assigns you an accent or way of speaking. You must maintain it for the entire round while having a normal conversation. British, surfer, pirate, news anchor — whatever's called.

2–8 players~6 minSilly & LoudActing & performance games🚗 Works in the car

How to play

  1. Each player is assigned an accent or speaking style by the group.
  2. For the next 5–10 minutes, everyone speaks only in their assigned style.
  3. Have a normal conversation — the content is normal, the voices are not.
  4. If you break character, you earn a penalty point.
  5. Switch accents each round.

Example round

  • Everyone is British. Someone asks what's for dinner. 'I dare say, a spot of pasta would be rather lovely.'
  • Pirate vs. surfer conversation: 'Yar, the waves be gnarly today, matey!' 'Dude, totally, bro.'
  • News anchor accent explaining why they're late to the party. Devastating.

Tips

  • Best accents for chaos: surfer, pirate, Shakespearean, infomercial presenter.
  • Give someone a style, not just an accent: 'speak like you're making an announcement'.
